status: Authored final design; asset integrity and geometry evidence in audit/yimen-v1
scope: Independent frontal-shape exterior candidate; documentary dimensions retained separately, with estimated 7.0 m model height not satisfying or resolving the documented 9.07 m; no full photographic, photo-proportion or geographic acceptance

documented.relative_position: 棂星门东、儒学署大门北

reference_period_limit: Old museum repair year 2001 and 2021 article multi-building project range 2001-04 to 2002-06 are retained separately. The 2023 article supplies a photograph with unknown capture date. No 2026 condition verification.

area_arithmetic_check.limit: Rounded arithmetic agreement does not establish whether the source measures column lines, wall lines, base or eaves.

photo_supported_front.caveat: Visible regions are not documented structural bays or confirmed operable leaf counts; metric positions and detailed geometry are estimated.

interpretations.measurement_endpoints: Documentary width and depth assigned to the local base as an interpretation. The 7.0 m model maximum height is an independent initial design estimate, not a pixel-to-metre measurement. Documentary height 9.07 m and its endpoints remain unresolved; the model does not force compliance or claim the source is wrong.
interpretations.local_axes: Local X width, local Y depth; front local -Y only for independent viewing, not a verified compass heading.
interpretations.roof_form: Continuous curved front slope based on visible silhouette; symmetric rear slope and all hidden roof connections are unverified design assumptions, not evidence of complete roof type.
interpretations.end_walls: High ends near ridge, descending curves and slight outer upturns; profile parameters, thickness, side depth and mirrored rear are estimates.
interpretations.inner_upright_sections: Estimated; the frontal image does not independently determine circular versus rectangular structural sections.
interpretations.lattice_small_cell_pattern: Original simplified repeated grid; exact cell and joinery counts are not recovered.
interpretations.curtain_design: Original closed-thickness folded curtain approximating visible beige folds; fold count and depth are estimates. No door leaves or interior are invented behind it.
interpretations.plaque: Blue-green face and border, blank face; no calligraphic or carved inscription reconstruction.

front_steps.status: Estimated short steps only; complete source step count and dimensions are obscured.

interpretations.colours_and_materials: Original gray tiles, pale plaster, brown wood and beige curtain approximations; no sampled photographic pixels or image textures.
interpretations.hidden_faces: Plain closure and estimated roof rear; no acceptance of unseen doors, windows or interior.

actual_export_envelope.scope: Computed from final GLB, including estimated front steps and tile ends; not the documentary footprint or eave endpoints.

height_comparison.limit: 7.0 m is an explicit design estimate for the frontal-shape candidate; not a measured or photograph-derived height. Source height and endpoint uncertainty must remain visible in the delivered documentation.

omitted: Hidden central door leaves and interior
Exact inscriptions, couplets, carvings and joinery
Plants, pots, exhibition signs and adjacent buildings
Surveyed courtyard paving and geographic registration
